text_block_list.text:
Today, I came to an art museum with Light Hello
to unwind and view the paintings.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... What a wonderful exhibition!
All those masterpieces lined up together.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Truly breathtaking.
My inspiration has been thoroughly stoked!
choice_data_list: Did you find anything you liked?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Yes! The traffic flow was incredible!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Yes! The visiting route, placement of exhibits, and angle of lighting are all designed with the visitor's line of sight and movement in mind.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Everything was calculated down to the finest detail... bringing out the true beauty of the paintings.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Ehehe.
It's weird that the traffic flow was the first thing that caught my eye, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Occupational habit――no, maybe I've been like this forever.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Rather than wanting to be someone who achieves great feats, I'm the type who prefers supporting those working hard to do so.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Well, it might just be that I lack the talent
to ever achieve anything great, though. ...Ahaha.
choice_data_list: Those feelings are a talent in their own right.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Th-Thank... you very much.
It's just, um... well...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Ahhh! Look over there!
It looks like the painting class is holding an event!?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Brainstorming and sharing ideas is crucial for project planning!
You should definitely participate! Come on!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Phew…… Well, I managed to finish it, at least.
Landscape painting sure is difficult.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Drawing what you see.
It's easy to say, but doing it is quite another...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: What about you, Trainer?
choice_data_list: For now, I managed to finish the drawing.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Whoa! What a lovely drawing... There's nothing makeshift about it at all!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
First, take a look at these line strokes! The thickness and depth,
combined with the overall texture, give it such an approachable feel.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
The gentle expressions on the passersby are so soothing too!
As expected of your character and artistic talent... Truly genius level!
choice_data_list: You're giving me too much credit……!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
That's not true at all!
If you compare it to my drawing, the difference is obvious.

Even so,
Light Hello's drawing captured the scenery's features
remarkably well, displaying her keen eye for detail.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
What do you think?
It's practically night and day, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: ...You really don't need to spare my feelings, I'm fine! I don't have any talent as a player to begin with—
choice_data_list: It captures the plant's features quite nicely, too.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... S-So you see...?
Please don't hold back, tell me what's wrong...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
B-But! The perspective is all weird in the first place.
A keen eye alone won't make you good at drawing!

text_block_list.name: Art Class Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, when you're expressing something through art,
your power of observation is what matters most~.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Art Class Teacher
text_block_list.text: Hehehe. Just as your companion said, I too think it's a magnificent painting.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: ...Ghhh.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
T-That's true.
It could serve as good reference for event planning.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Um, but, well... I'm not really
used to being told... things like that, you see...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: ........Gimme a break already~~!
Looking embarrassed, she flusteredly packed up her things. But... she tucked the drawing carefully into her bag all the same.
